cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put your umbrella back, open like you leave yours. It'll be ready for work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only leave it open to dry. Why is it wet? It hasn't rained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, drying first. I gave it a rinse. I'll wipe the handle before you go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's pondweed caught in the spokes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll rinse that out too. Have your breakfast; I'll get it dry and back in the stand before you need it.

reason: Use concrete copied misunderstandings to shape control, quiet restoration, detail diversion, protective handling or inquiry, with each B contribution changing A's next move.
